description: Enterprise techniques used by DEEPROOT, ATT&CK software S9063 (v1.0)
name: DEEPROOT (S9063)

techniques.comment: [DEEPROOT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9063) has received hex-encoded payloads from the C2 server where the values are separated by “-===-“.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[DEEPROOT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9063) has a delay function that is capable of sleeping before making subsequent requests.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[DEEPROOT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9063) has the ability to upload files to C2.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[DEEPROOT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9063) has communicated with multiple C2 servers as a means of redundancy if one fails.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[DEEPROOT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9063) can gather file and directory details.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[DEEPROOT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9063) has the ability to delete files.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[DEEPROOT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9063) has the ability to download files from C2.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[DEEPROOT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9063) has gathered the victim hostname.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[DEEPROOT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9063) can obtain the victim’s username.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
